object.attr: derived: CF-S29, E2, F14. The record that returns files is in memory, so a kill or power loss leaves the operation half applied (a delete can strip incoming links and keep the object), and nothing says so. Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S1); the record is kept under .git, so it is never committed.
object.description: If Mellon stopped while an operation was under way, Mellon shall report the operation and each file the operation wrote or deleted when Mellon next opens the repository.
